title: Add: catalog item reviews
prompt: Customers can review catalog items: a rating from 1 to 5 and optional text up to 1,000 characters. Add endpoints to add a review to an item and to list an item's reviews.
done: reviews can be added to an item (rating 1 to 5 enforced, optional text up to 1,000 characters) and an item's reviews listed, through the new endpoints

expect.text: The Domain designer has the review entity with its rating (int) and optional text (max length 1000), related to CatalogItem as it is in the code.
The Services designer has both new operations (add a review to an item, list an item's reviews) with the verbs, routes and parameter sources the code uses.
The add operation has a create interaction (a create entity action) for the review.
The list operation has a query interaction on what the code reads: the reviews, or CatalogItem with its reviews.
